title: limonium aureum var. potaninii
intro: Limonium aureum var. potaninii, commonly known as Golden Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Golden Sea Lavender include its sedative, antidepressant, and antispasmodic effects, which may aid in the treatment of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
